packageRules.description: Batch updates across managers into one PR; major updates still get their own PR. Repositories give updates that need manual review a separate group so they do not block automerge for the rest
Keep breaking non-major updates, such as 0.x minor bumps, out of the automerged group so they do not hold it back
Pin digests without waiting for the release-age cooldown and automerge them: the referenced version does not change
Automerge non-breaking updates after CI and cooldown. Digest updates have no isBreaking value, and a JSONata comparison with a missing value is false, so test for isBreaking = true instead of != true
These 0.x tools ship routine releases as minor and patch bumps, which Renovate marks as breaking. Keep them in the automerged group; majors still get their own PR
